title: Book 1: Sanctuary on Caelum-IV (Movement IV — Stardate 49601)
description: Having reached escape velocity and crossed 1,200 light-years through the FTL Harmonic Continuum, the crew of the U.S.S. Aethelgard sets down on Caelum-IV ('Sanctuary')—the 0.90G outer rocky moon of the ringed gas giant Vespera (Kepler-442c). Retiring Earth's calendar for Stardate 49601.0 under a permanent golden-violet twilight, the family lowers the aft cargo ramp onto compacted basaltic purple sand and discovers a planetary intelligence that communicates entirely through sympathetic musical resonance.
